entry.title: Catherine Zeta-Jones Says Michael Douglas Fell for Her in ‘Zorro’ | Building Character | BAZAAR

media:group.media:title: Catherine Zeta-Jones Says Michael Douglas Fell for Her in ‘Zorro’ | Building Character | BAZAAR
media:group.media:description:
Catherine Zeta-Jones has brought some of Hollywood’s most unforgettable characters and their wardrobes to life. In this episode of “Building Character,” the Academy and Tony Award–winning actress reflects on the roles that changed her career, from her first television job at 19 in ‘The Darling Buds of May’ to being cast by Steven Spielberg as Elena Montero in ‘The Mask of Zorro’ and landing her dream role as Velma in ‘Chicago.’ She also shares memories of working with Sean Connery in ‘Entrapment,’ joining the ‘Ocean’s 12’ gang, building her relationship with Jenna Ortega in ‘Wednesday,’ and finally getting to use her Welsh accent in ‘Kill Jackie.’
Stream ‘Kill Jackie’ on AMC+.
